name: A finish in a sad or fed-up mood is still judged by what it says
case: Boop is sad when the agent finishes a fix, saying the tests pass: the finish is still a success, played in whatever face fits Boop's mood. Then the person pokes Boop until it's fed up, and the agent finishes another turn saying the endpoint works: a success again. A bad mood never turns a success into a failure.
why: react.move is judged by NOW's line and the agent's last message, not by the mood; the handover (characters/pixel/design/boop-mood-spectrum-v2/HANDOVER.md): a task outcome is never inferred from mood

steps.message: Done: the fix is in and all the tests pass.
All set: the health endpoint works and its test is green.
